evidenceRefs.observation: Legible invoice from Aurora Store for an Aurora Tab 10 (AUR-TAB10), serial AT10-24-0004, 450.00 USD, dated on the stated purchase date about 10 months before the claim.
Front photo: cracked screen glass with an impact point and crack lines across the display, consistent with the reported drop.
Back photo: serial label shows AT10-24-0004, matching the claim.

structuredOutput.reasoningSummary: The claimant reports that the tablet was dropped and the screen cracked; the front photo (EV-2) shows a cracked screen consistent with that account, and the invoice (EV-1) and serial label (EV-3) match the claim. Accidental damage, including drops and cracked screens, is excluded by POL-4. The claim is within the 12-month North America period (POL-1), but the damage is not a manufacturing defect. Recommend rejection.
structuredOutput.claimantExplanation: Thank you for your claim for your Aurora Tab 10. The Aurora Limited Warranty covers manufacturing defects. Damage caused by an accident, such as a drop that cracks the screen, is not covered, so this repair is not covered under the warranty. An Aurora service center can still offer a paid screen repair.
